title: Isaiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 15
description: Ten questions on Isaiah 15: the burden of Moab, cities laid waste in a night, wailing in sackcloth, and the waters of Dimon full of blood.

questions.text: Isaiah 15 is the burden of which nation?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 opens with "The burden of Moab," whose cities Ar and Kir are laid waste.

questions.text: In what span of time are Ar of Moab and Kir of Moab laid waste?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says that in a night Ar of Moab is laid waste, and in a night Kir of Moab is laid waste and brought to nothing.

questions.text: According to verse 2, what is on all of their heads?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says Moab wails over Nebo and Medeba; baldness is on all of their heads and every beard is cut off.

questions.text: What do the people clothe themselves in, in their streets?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 says that in their streets they clothe themselves in sackcloth, and everyone wails on the housetops.

questions.text: Heshbon cries out together with which place?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says Heshbon cries out with Elealeh, and their voice is heard even to Jahaz.

questions.text: To where do the nobles of Moab flee?
questions.explanation: Verse 5 says her nobles flee to Zoar, to Eglath Shelishiyah, going up the ascent of Luhith with weeping.

answers.text: To the fords of the Arnon

questions.text: What will happen to the waters of Nimrim?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 says the waters of Nimrim will be desolate, the grass has withered away, and there is no green thing.

answers.text: They will be stopped up with stones

questions.text: Over what will the people carry away the abundance they have stored up?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 says they will carry their abundance and what they have stored up over the brook of the willows.

answers.text: Over the brook of the willows

questions.text: To which places has the wailing of Moab gone?
questions.explanation: Verse 8 says the cry has gone around the borders of Moab, its wailing to Eglaim and to Beer Elim.

answers.text: To Eglaim and to Beer Elim

questions.text: What are the waters of Dimon full of, and what more will come?
questions.explanation: Verse 9 says the waters of Dimon are full of blood, and a lion will come on those of Moab who escape.

answers.text: Fish, and a famine on the land
Blood, and a lion on those who escape
Mud, and a drought on the fields
Salt, and a plague on the cattle
